description.raw: '''Innate:''' '''Soraka''' gains [[File:Movement speed icon.png|15px|link=Movement speed]] 90% '''bonus''' movement speed while facing nearby allied [[File:Champion icon.png|20px|link=Champion|An icon representing the keyword Champion]] [[:Champion|champions]] that are below 40% of their '''maximum''' health.
